gaps: The catalog cannot directly assert the AI recommendation content or independently verify that the proposal allocation exactly matches the AI decision.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFx event with bids on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding screen where Smart Awarding and Create Proposal are available.

args.goal: On the awarding screen, click Smart Awarding next to Create Proposal, select Best Value Vendor Selection in the Procol AI side panel, click the blue send icon, review the AI suggested awarding plan, then click Create Proposal and stop on the created proposal screen.

Verify that Create Proposal resulted in the proposal screen.
